shell.unreachable: The portal cannot reach Bizora right now. Try again in a minute.

signIn.title: Bizora staff only
signIn.lead: Sign in with the Google account your team lead added to the staff list.

errors.not_allowed: That Google account is not on the staff list. Ask a super admin to add your email.
errors.removed: You were removed from the staff list. Ask a super admin if this is a mistake.
errors.unverified: Google has not confirmed that email address yet.
errors.different_account: That email is on the staff list with a different Google account. Use the account you signed in with before, or ask a super admin.
errors.expired: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.google: Google did not finish the sign-in. Try again.

find.title: Find a business or a person
find.searchBusinesses: Business name, link name, owner email or phone
find.noPeople: No person or invitation matches that.
find.typeToSearch: Type a name or email to look someone up.

business.privacy: You see the account, not the records. Sales, money and customers stay private.
business.storage: {photos, plural, =0 {No product photos} one {# product photo} other {# product photos}}, {size} stored
business.usageLine: {sales, plural, =0 {No sales} one {# sale} other {# sales}} in the last 30 days · {products, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} · {customers, plural, one {# customer} other {# customers}}
business.limitsLead: The plan gives the starting numbers. A number set here replaces the plan's for this business only.

limitNames.ai_daily_reads: Photo and voice reads a shop a day

business.serverCap: Reads are also capped at {count} a day for the whole service.
business.supportViewLead: See this business's sales, stock, customers and money, read-only, for one hour. The owner agreed to this in the Terms of use and sees every page you open.
business.featuresLead: Switch a part of Bizora off for this business only, for example during the pilot. The owner sees every change and its reason.

featureNames.photo_reads: Bizora AI reads photos and voice notes

featureHints.offline_voice: Experimental. The phone turns speech into a sale for the trader to check. A phone that already downloaded voice keeps the files until it is removed in Settings.
featureHints.photo_reads: Photos and voice notes are sent to Google Cloud and come back as drafts to check.
featureHints.support_view: Bizora support may open a read-only view of this business's records, with a reason.
featureHints.advanced_accounting: Not built. Off for every business.
featureHints.payment_gateways: Not built. Off for every business; payments are recorded as cash, transfer or POS.

business.sample: Sample business, made for demonstrations. Not counted in pilot measures. Remove it with the sample-business script (see the pilot runbook).

person.devices: {count, plural, =0 {Not signed in anywhere} one {Signed in on # device} other {Signed in on # devices}}
person.signOutHint: Use when a phone or laptop is lost, or the person thinks someone else has their password.

reason.label: Why are you doing this?
reason.hint: The business owner can see this, with your email.
reason.placeholder: For example: owner asked on WhatsApp, ticket 1042

resendInvitation.title: Send the invitation again
resendInvitation.description: {email} gets a new link. The old link stops working.

stopDevice.title: Stop this shop phone
stopDevice.description: {name} is signed out and cannot be used for this business again. The owner can add a new phone.

resendVerification.title: Send the confirmation email again
resendVerification.description: {email} gets a new link to confirm the address.

signOutEverywhere.title: Sign out everywhere
signOutEverywhere.description: {name} is signed out on every phone and computer and must sign in again.

removeStaff.title: Remove from staff
removeStaff.description: {email} is signed out and can no longer use the portal.

changeRoles.title: Change roles
changeRoles.description: {email} gets the roles you picked the next time they open a page.

openSupportView.title: Open the support view
openSupportView.description: You see {name}'s records read-only for one hour. Your email and this reason are shown to the owner.

changeLimits.title: Change limits
changeLimits.description: Leave a box empty to use the plan's number. The owner sees this change.

featureOff.title: Switch off: {name}
featureOff.description: It stops for everyone in this business straight away.

featureOn.title: Switch on: {name}
featureOn.description: It is available to this business straight away.

staff.title: Bizora staff
staff.lead: Only these Google accounts can sign in. Every change is kept in the staff log.
staff.name: Name

roleHints.support: Look up businesses and people, resend links, sign people out, stop phones
roleHints.finance: Look up businesses and their plans

audit.title: Staff log
audit.lead: What Bizora staff did and looked at, newest first. Nothing here can be changed.

errors.notFound: Not found. It may have been removed.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.

records.title: Support view: {name}
records.closed: The support view is closed. Open it again from the business page.
records.masked: Customers' phone numbers and emails are partly hidden.
records.profitParts: Sales {sales} · cost of goods {cost} · running costs {expenses} · POS fees {fees}
records.totalStock: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}}, worth {value} at selling price
records.totalOwed: {count, plural, one {# customer owes} other {# customers owe}} {amount}

measures.title: Pilot measures
measures.lead: How each business is using Bizora. Counts only: no customer names, no amounts per sale, nothing anyone typed or said.
measures.sampleNote: Sample businesses are listed but not counted in the totals. Voice measures come from phones and are lost if a phone closes while offline, so they undercount.

firstSteps.title: First steps
firstSteps.lead: How many businesses have ever done each of these, counted from their records. Sample businesses are left out.

health.title: Last 7 days
health.none: No refused offline changes or voice problems in the last 7 days.
health.logsHint: App errors are in Cloud Logging and Error Reporting (search by the business's ID). See the pilot runbook.

lifecycle.title: Suspension
lifecycle.activeLine: Bizora has not suspended this business.
lifecycle.suspendDescription: Nothing can be recorded from any phone or session until it is reinstated. The owner can still read and download records, and sees the category but not your note. Work waiting on phones stays there.
lifecycle.reinstateDescription: The business can record again, and work waiting on phones is sent. For fraud or security, someone other than the person who suspended must do this.

reasons.terms: Breach of the Terms of use
